data.long_meaning: Arnab is a Sanskrit name derived from the word ‘arnava’, which means ‘golden’ or ‘eagle’. This name is associated with strength, courage, and the ability to soar above challenges. In Hindu mythology, Arnab is believed to be the name of a mighty eagle-like creature.
